title: DRI Voyager Data Prep Input File
description: Input to voyager-preppy: a flat array of objects, each declaring a flat variants[] (ADR-0002 amended — no geometry grouping). Each variant becomes one self-contained glb; each object gets one per-object manifest.

urlSafe.description: URL-safe identifier used in filenames/URIs; case preserved as authored.

localizedString.description: A plain string, or a map of locale code to string.

nodataFill.description: Atlas no-data fill color to back-fill from the nearest valid chart pixel before KTX2 encoding (e.g. '#FF7F00'). null disables an inherited default; absent means no back-fill. Resolved variant ?? object ?? CLI default.

object.description: One imaged object (one manifest / one scene).

id.description: Stable object id; the manifest id and default output-folder/file prefix.

prefix.description: Optional output folder + filename prefix; defaults to id.

units.description: Measurement units for the scene (default: cm).

variants.description: Flat list of variants; each becomes one self-contained glb.

variant.description: One mesh + its texture(s) for an object.

suffix.description: Stable variant key: names the file and is the manifest variant id (deep-link key).

label.description: Display-only variant label (falls back to suffix).

obj.description: Path to the variant's OBJ (absolute, or relative to --data-root, which defaults to the current working directory).

default.description: Marks the initial variant. Exactly one variant per object is the default (the first, if none set this).
